\title{\textbf{The Renewal Grand Tensor}\\[0.35em]
\Large Operationally Complete Microscopic Emergence and Domain-Specific\\
SM--Spacetime and Arithmetic Loadings, Dualities, and Interfaces\\[0.4em]
\large Version V035}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
The Renewal Grand Tensor is reconstructed from complete finite operational
process data and the actual readable-record interface, not from a hidden state
space, a selected target algebra, or separately supplied positive process
combs.  A generated classical ledger is first reduced to the unique smallest
typed right congruence through which every admitted record-conditioned future
factors.  This minimization is terminating, stable under unread refinements,
and must precede completion of the record writers to a $C^*$-history algebra.
Dual-frame tomography then reconstructs the finite process tensors; positivity,
causal trace recursion, and prefix compatibility are consistency tests on the
probability table.  The record-conditioned Hankel quotient gives the minimal
linear predictor and its table-native executable algebra, while the positive
comb selects the canonical support-minimal sequential CP class.  The complete
mixed-word maps generate the process-history $C^*$-algebra, its contextual
future radical gives the unique minimal context-preserving separated envelope,
and the normalized regular trace produces a finite flat word-Gram hierarchy
which reconstructs the unit, involution, multiplication, minimal record
algebra, conditional predictive algebras, and every represented mixed history.

The definition used by the domain sections is strengthened accordingly.  The
structural tensor reconstructed from the original Store cylinder is retained as
an exact forgetful shadow, but the unqualified Renewal Grand Tensor now means
the conservative relational completion
$\mathsf P_X^{\rm rel}=\mathsf P_X^{\rm old}\ltimes
\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}$.  The future-minimal packet is the recurrent
same-history record
$(Z_n,\Gamma_n,O_n,\Xi_n,Z_{n+1})$: it carries the persistent relational state,
the old Store outcome and its $A_3$ root, a scheduler-separated fast root path,
the determining-field, nuisance, reward, and action marks, and the next
relational state.  Forgetting this packet recovers every old Store cylinder
exactly.  Across cutoffs, one paired old--detail polarization table supplies the
Schur-compatible refinement data.  Thus persistence, spatial routing, mixed
source orientation, and the common field/action interface are no longer
reintroduced as unrelated downstream primitives.

The scheduler-separated geometric branch is realized explicitly rather than
left as a nonempty abstract alternative.  On the scalar-period $A_3$ quotient,
symmetric root clocks of order $h^{-2}$ and the fast speed measure produce a
faithful ten-dimensional ADM score frame, order-$h$ edge conductances, a
uniform three-dimensional cut margin, compact Hodge screens, and an exact flat
vacuum limit.  Multiplying the common root rate by $e^{-2Ht}$ and the speed
density by $e^{3Ht}$ gives a second conservative regulator with
$g(t)=e^{2Ht}g_0$, unit lapse, summable Cartan--Palatini consistency defects,
and the constant-curvature vacuum equation
$G_{\mu\nu}+3H^2g_{\mu\nu}=0$.  Thus the repaired primitive has both flat and
genuinely curved vacuum spacetime realizations without a primitive metric,
coframe, connection, or curvature tensor.


The relational cutoff packet is further organized by a typed closure profile.
A loaded sector is classified by its native closure algebra---positive interior,
protected angle, signed action with open current, ordered boundary, or an
unloaded source/object interface---and is audited by its observable support
grade, interaction closure order, response-backbone dimension, source
observability, local margin, canonical exceptional screen, boundary current,
unbounded directions, and source-completeness residual.  These coordinates are
invariants of the operationally loaded packet.  In particular, a finite
spectral gap cannot be used as a surrogate for a protected phase angle, a
primitive boundary source, an invisible physical sector, or a cutoff-uniform
transport theorem.

For a positive head--detail action carrying an actual boundary map, elimination
must be performed after the interior and boundary rows have been assembled.
If $S$ is the ordinary interior Schur complement, $E$ the boundary source on
the harmonic lift, and $K$ the detail boundary-relaxation operator, the exact
head action is
\[
 \boxed{S+E^*(I+K)^{-1}E.}
\]
The positive difference $E^*K(I+K)^{-1}E$ is the precise overestimate incurred
by freezing the interior harmonic lift before allowing the boundary to relax.
The canonical exceptional carrier at threshold $\beta$ is the spectral screen
$\one_{[0,\beta)}(A)$; it is the unique minimum reducing screen on which the
margin $A\succeq\beta(I-Z)$ can hold.

Part~I strengthens this finite theorem in three directions.  First, any finite
collection of jointly visible typed source families has a canonical positive
block Gram, a source-minimal common dilation, mutual Schur innovations,
Anderson--Trapp shorts, and normalized cross-source transports.  These objects
are independent of Kraus and purification coordinates, invariant under unread
record refinements, unique up to a source-fixing unitary, and strictly
functorial under cutoff refinement when all mixed blocks compress.  A single
joint score table reconstructs the same cross Gram, and efficient-score
projection is exactly simultaneous nuisance shorting.  Thus independently
canonical sectors no longer possess an arbitrary relative orientation once
the mixed operational panel is retained.


The joint-source calculus is further refined into a hierarchy of source,
coherence, and transport completeness.  A complete cross-record source kernel
reconstructs the source-minimal linear atlas up to one global unitary, while
conditional expectation onto an actual physical record gives the unique
source-sufficient quotient and its positive hidden-source innovation.  This
linear overlap geometry does not determine a physical connection.  After an
independently loaded transport is supplied, the record-visible source admits
an exact covariant Hodge decomposition into minimum demand action, minimum
open-boundary current, and internal cycle current.  At higher grade, the
pairwise kernel remains only a linear shadow: stabilized word Grams reconstruct
the source algebra, and a positive monoidal residual tests whether a proposed
transport preserves the unit, involution, multiplication, and physical
occurrence law.  Flat Hilbert-space holonomy may therefore coexist with a
nonzero word-level transport defect.

Signed observables are retained before scalarization.  After the canonical
cycle and nuisance shorts, a real or phase-valued source separates into a
coherent resultant, a countercoherent or counterflow component, local
coherence loss, deterministic holonomy, open current, and boundary writing.
A positive action prices only the source component actually incident with its
transport carrier; it does not by itself select a circulating or flat
orientation.  Independently, finite Hermitian compressions admit
coordinate-free inertia, rank--trace, and signed Feshbach certificates.  These
control populations and threshold indices without manufacturing a canonical
residual eigenspace or determining the protected phase.  The coercive,
inertial, and causal-signed branches are consequently retained as distinct but
compatible outputs of one complete mixed carrier.

Second, the renewal-native microscopic source is sharpened into a canonical
primitive floor rather than a preferred hidden ontology.  For every finite
lift of the visible renewal transfer, the hidden carrier has a canonical
filtration into a source-reachable future-sealed sector and a minimal returned-
feedback quotient.  The returned kernels $K_n=BD^nC$ are recursively
reconstructed from the visible compressed powers, and their stabilized
block-Hankel rank is the exact number of additional recurrent coordinates.
Hence an exact realization of the full active word table admits no finite
hidden excursion that later returns to the active renewal.  After branch
resolution, a noncommutative Schur inversion reconstructs every coefficient
$B_bD_uC_a$ and rules out cancellation between hidden excursions.  The only
source-reachable exact finite extensions are therefore one-way provenance
extensions.  Once passive provenance Reads are declared, their centered
responses have a canonical reachable--observable Hankel quotient; without
such Reads, arbitrary sealed writers and spectators remain nonidentifiable.
There is consequently a canonical minimal primitive quotient, but no canonical
finest microscopic lift.

The same distinction now governs every physical response and shell map.  A
response word table controls only the source-cyclic carrier generated by its
physical writers.  Relative to an independently complete writer atlas, a
positive atlas residual returns the exact missing source directions; only after
that residual vanishes may a response localizer be promoted to a full-carrier
coercive statement.  This yields a two-margin theorem separating source
observability from physical coercivity and an exact response-backbone count
from spectral multiplicity.  For a retained-plus-tail shell linearization
$\begin{psmallmatrix}A&B\\C&D\end{psmallmatrix}$, the reduced derivative is
$A+B(I-D)^{-1}C$ and depends only on the returned words $BD^nC$.  Their
stabilized block-Hankel rank is the unique minimum tail dimension visible to
the retained sector; exact staged elimination is associative, while a vanishing
aggregate self-energy does not imply absence of returned dynamics.

Structural realization, parameter calibration, future-state closure,
independent numerical selection, and nested Wilsonian closure are therefore
kept distinct.  A direct-versus-projected two-shell row is held out only when
the direct coarse law was not used to fit the intermediate projected maps; at
a tail-free base point its derivative is the first-return product $B_2C_1$.
A local selector Gram must additionally be supplemented by a finite-orbit
separation whenever a coarse packet forgets a sign, chirality, or conjugate
branch.

For the concrete source, the active quotient is exactly
\[
 M_0=\begin{pmatrix}1/5&4/5\\[0.15em]2/3&1/3\end{pmatrix},
 \qquad
 \pi=(5/11,6/11),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{spec}M_0=\{1,-7/15\}.
\]
It has the completed-private law
\[
 F_W(z)=\frac{8z^2}{(5-z)(3-z)},\qquad
 \mathbb EW=\frac{11}{4},\qquad
 \Pr(W>N)=6\,3^{-N}-5\,5^{-N},
\]
active rank two, flux $4/11$, stationary metric condition number $6/5$,
contraction $(7/15)^n$, a fresh fair endpoint, and zero old-private routing
into the active recurrent future.  The completed branch is precisely the first
rank-one predictive reset, whereas every pure survivor prefix remains rank
two.  The scalar waiting law alone leaves a one-parameter family of positive
two-state quotients; the resolved phase and zero-back-transition Reads select
$M_0$.  Horizon extension gives a projectively consistent infinite marked path
law.  Trace-preserving spectators and independent parallel-cell growth are
exact regulators, while interacting extensions are governed by the returned-
feedback and source-influence certificates.  The locked $25$-record
edge/order/charge phase remains a separate synchronized physical loading.

The numerical renewal law is further separated from any unobserved explanation
of its opportunity weights.  Once the four entry labels and two completion
labels are internally regular, the only remaining source defects are two
rank-one cross-fibre Ward coordinates; on a verified exchange branch one
delayed binary nonwriting-versus-writing Read per phase evaluates them and
forces $1/5$ and $1/3$.  The currently declared fresh terminal interface does
not contain those pre-writer histories: every stationary hidden sampler with
the same source law is invisible to the complete downstream multitime table.
The selected coefficients therefore remain exact measured source data unless
those two additional ports or equivalent common-action derivatives are
physically supplied.  A signed completion-aggregated provenance panel is more
favorable: the geometric private dwell acts by an invertible
linear-fractional transform and reconstructs the complete centered one-way
provenance channel from one mixed panel.  The discrete recurrent step has a
negative transient eigenvalue and is not a deterministic continuous-time
Markov step; Poisson uniformization instead gives the positive generator with
rates $4\lambda/5$ and $2\lambda/3$, relaxation rate $22\lambda/15$, and
physical completion intensity $4\lambda/11$.

An explicit interacting regulator is also obtained by adjoining reversible
nearest-neighbor phase interchange to independent local renewal.  Its product
state is exact, every exposed interchange derivative is a genuinely connected
two-site response, and its spectral gap is exactly $22\lambda/15$ uniformly
in volume and graph geometry.  On diffusively scaled three-tori its stationary
fluctuation field converges dynamically to the massive generalized
Ornstein--Uhlenbeck field.  For a positive environment-modulated interchange,
the exact first-chaos action is the Schur short of the higher-chaos block and
the projected dynamics obeys a Mori--Zwanzig equation with a positive memory
kernel.  Two-, three-, and four-particle exclusion cells determine the unique
frequency-independent continuum response through sixth order in the
modulation: the mass and transverse diffusivities are unchanged, the selected
diffusivity has an explicit anisotropic expansion, and every finite-frequency
memory mass is $O(|\theta|^7)$.  The nonperturbative spatial problem is also
closed for this explicit regulator.  The normalized higher-sector insertion
is tridiagonal in Walsh degree, its large-degree tail is exponentially small,
and a parity-corrected hard-core collision Hodge induction gives a uniform
source-specific $H_{-2}$ profile at every fixed degree.  The exact corrector
therefore disappears and the corrected bracket self-averages throughout
$|\theta|\|\varphi\|_\infty<1$.  Once the deterministic shorted forms converge,
the complete fixed-coupling field converges to the generalized
Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process with covariance twice the limiting shorted action.
This closes the stochastic analysis of the specified regulator; it does not
show that the fresh Store autonomously realizes that interaction.




The resolved primitive branch law also has a complete intrinsic score geometry.
After conditional centering, its one-step tangent space is exactly three
dimensional.  It splits orthogonally into the normalized active Doob innovation,
a route-provenance innovation, and the fresh endpoint-sign innovation.  In the
physical coordinates the source metric is
$\operatorname{diag}(176/225,1,1)$; it is simultaneously the Fisher information
and the Hessian of the primitive conditional relative entropy.  The fresh score
bank is a martingale-difference source with exact fluctuation--dissipation
innovation, gives a three-component Brownian scaling limit, and produces three
orthogonal tetrahedral standard triplets on four independent cells.  These
statements are unconditional consequences of the resolved renewal table; they
do not by themselves assert an inter-cell interaction or a spacetime semantic.

Third, one globally consistent operational cylinder process now derives the
strict raw cutoff system, its cylinder state, and the finite record, predictor,
context, and source innovations; prefix exactness is no longer an independent
entrance hypothesis.  Summable state, source, observable, and dynamics defects
have canonical exactly compatible corrections with explicit tail bounds, while
arbitrary families have compact projective cluster-state sets and finite
separators.  Renormalization is promoted to a linear--affine metric cocycle with
classified scale, support, and orientation moduli.  Closed semibounded forms on
changing Hilbert spaces are controlled by an exact Mosco--resolvent theorem,
compact graph screens, spectral-mass alternatives, and primitive-word soft-mode
witnesses.

Part~I-C reconstructs operational locality from simultaneously shorted
connected panels and now places renewal-boundary coercivity on the same
intrinsic footing.  A passive marked interface with exponentially controlled
survival reconstructs a canonical boundary-to-boundary cycle channel and its
analytic return pencil.  For every current/outgoing source pair, the complete
boundary Gram separates physical dissipation, finite-head leakage, and
common-action mismatch by one exact positive Ward--graph identity.  A joint
current/mean/noise panel further separates the predictable geometric mean from
the primitive martingale covariance by an exact Anderson--Trapp short; the raw
order-$\tau$ fluctuation term and the noise-shorted $o(\tau^2)$ deterministic
Ward residual are therefore compatible rather than competing scalings.

The same differentiated operational calculus now reconstructs efficient
connected scores.  For two primitive cells the complete first-order connected
carrier is the nine-dimensional tensor square of the one-cell score bank, with
metric $G_0\otimes G_0$.  On four cells the Hoeffding support decomposition is
exhaustive: the pair, triple, and four-body sectors have dimensions $54$, $108$,
and $81$.  Exact $S_4$ covariance reduces the complete support audit to one
prototype per support order.  On the pairwise branch, one positive edge Hessian
splits canonically into a metric router and an additional connected source;
cycle products reconstruct operational holonomy, and a tree--holonomy
observability inequality gives coercivity without assuming flatness.  For a
tetrahedral $S_4$ branch, one ordered-edge router and one prototype triangle
determine the complete connection, curvature scaling, and a quantitative local
Hodge floor.  An explicit periodic covariant regulator has norm-resolvent and
heat-semigroup convergence to the corresponding continuum connection
Laplacian.

The connected-panel calculus is provenance aware.  A signed completion-
aggregated provenance source has the same physical range as the complete
centered private channel, and simultaneous shorting by one-cell, protected,
mediator, and provenance directions gives an exact positive correction to the
raw interaction Gram.  Its unsigned marginal Gram is insufficient because it
forgets the physical source range.  Conditional score panels reconstruct every
pair, triple, and four-body Hoeffding Gram by a finite M\"obius transform; under
exact $S_4$ covariance one panel per retained cardinality is sufficient, and
after constant and one-cell shorting three nonnegative prototype energies
decide the complete support branch.  A tetrahedral provenance triplet can
remove only one multiplicity direction in the standard isotypic block and
cannot affect inequivalent symmetry sectors.


The common positive-form calculus is also strengthened upstream of an assumed
derivative.  Actual neighbouring laws carry a canonical Hellinger source Gram;
simultaneous nuisance shorting is exact at finite separation, and an
independently physical shrinking family converges to the efficient Fisher
Hessian.  Finite secants, physical tangents, and dynamical actions are thereby
kept distinct.  For every positive action and protected observable bank, the
Moore--Penrose influence Gram is the sharp observability constant.  Exact
head--tail elimination preserves this influence through the Feshbach action,
while a computable approximate corrector certifies the effective floor.  When
several local mixed packets are assembled, the short of the complete packet is
the sum of the local shorts plus a positive router-dispersion Gram; shorting
before assembly can therefore erase the global orientation required by a
Ward, endpoint, or interface estimate.

The connected-source theory is promoted from a support decomposition to a
graded occurrence calculus.  Complete mixed occurrence Grams reconstruct
canonical fusion isometries, positive fusion innovations, and associator
residuals.  Proper-subset shorting leaves the all-residual Hoeffding sector,
which splits orthogonally into a product-connected tensor and a genuinely
nonmonoidal occurrence sector.  Boolean M\"obius inversion reconstructs the
signed interaction hierarchy from actual subset semigroups; these signed
cumulants need not be positive.  Positivity belongs instead to the complete
all-residual action after occurrence Feshbach reduction, and the retained
source must be reduced by the same router.  Actual intervention cubes provide
finite Hellinger interaction secants before any tangent is assumed, while
physical shrinking cubes recover the efficient all-support Fisher action.

Finally, one contraction organizes three complementary outputs.  Its fixed
projection measures invariant leakage and equals the minimum coboundary
residual; invariant actions and nuisance ranges decompose characterwise, so
nontrivial characters yield Ward cancellation while the zero character carries
invariant Hodge data.  The complementary open-boundary source has a canonical
minimum current and Wasserstein cost, which cannot be preserved by artificial
periodic closure.  These results give one precise five-arm interface: degree-one
fixed leakage for GRH, invariant faithfulness for the Hodge benchmark, an open
current for Navier--Stokes, a fixed-free positive transfer gap for
Yang--Mills, and higher tensor-neutral leakage for affine-linear prime systems.
The five loadings share a rigorous graded mechanism, but no conjecture transfer
is asserted without an actual source fusion, action, boundary map, and
regulator comparison in the domain.

A regenerative complete-observability packet then combines source-frame
noncollapse, cycle Lyapunov contraction, relative fluctuation--dissipation,
noise-shorted action comparison, shorted Hodge coercivity, compact Lyapunov
drift, and either ballistic or diffusive locality.  The growing protected
chronology is proved incapable of carrying a uniform transient gap under
uniformly conditioned metrics and is therefore shorted as a protected sector;
a uniformly stable one-way local provenance quotient instead carries a
canonical word-Gram Lyapunov metric without a small-writer assumption.  Consequently compatible
stationary states, faithful source covariances, nontriviality, unbounded-field
tightness, compact screens, and a noncollapsing physical rate can be discharged
by one renewal-native quantitative branch plus the pressure/locality scaling
law.  The actual interacting regulator must still supply its connected support
panels, edge innovations, internal connection fibre, prototype holonomy, and
$o(\tau)$ predictable-mean comparison.  Finite positivity, finite gaps, or
pointwise completeness alone still do not imply uniform continuum control.

The positive continuum branch is further reduced to finite operational
quantities.  On a physically weighted endpoint--edge atlas, canonical
three-dimensional pressure demands satisfy an exact max-flow/min-cut identity:
a regulator-uniform pressure-congestion margin is equivalent to the cut
isoperimetric inequality and yields the $L^6$ Sobolev estimate, a physical
Poincar\'e floor, $R^{3/2}$ low-energy counting, and uniformly exhausted compact
screens.  Protected directional cochains integrate into coordinate writers
exactly when their face curls and integral periods vanish; unit-successor
histories reconstruct Cartesian chart images, while deletion-resistant
interface capacities glue a finite chart atlas without a macroscopic neck.
For protected vector rewards on one marked first-return record, the renewal
pressure reconstructs the missing affine action derivative and its first two
jets reconstruct the complete mixed physical-action Gram.  Common-action,
potential, and counterterm exactness reduce to finite curl, period, and Schur
residuals.  Finally, Hodge-dominated loaded feedback has a compact Hankel
operator with dimension-three singular-value decay $O(n^{-2/3})$; at every
fixed physical resolution it is a finite auxiliary-field completion plus a
small local high-energy correction and a vanishing memory tail.  The concrete accepted-response renewal closes the corresponding temporal pressure and
fast-phase feedback margins exactly.  The global classical boundary is now a
finite cylinder compiler rather than an unnamed continuum assumption.  Physical
face-match Reads reconstruct the endpoint coequalizer; simultaneous
nuisance/provenance shorting reconstructs the efficient edge capacities; and
max-flow/min-cut computes the exact dimension-three cut constant.  The complete
determining-field future quotient reconstructs the table-native accepted
kernel, while the same-history Fisher--Bregman, or finite Gibbs/KL, gap decides
whether the accepted response is generated by the reconstructed common action.
Uniform cut coercivity and a vanishing accepted/action gap yield the weak
Einstein--matter handoff; failure returns an explicit endpoint, cut/potential,
likelihood-ratio, source-innovation, or escaping-mode witness.  Two conservative
extensions prove that neither the global atlas nor the accepted field update is
forced by the marginal one-cell renewal law.

The local spatial dimension is now selected within the same operational
minimality framework rather than inserted through a preferred coordinate
count.  A primitive one-source/one-target relation gives a signed edge after
physical reversal; future minimization removes unread parallel labels, and a
positive unordered-pair exchange gap makes a nonempty homogeneous relation
cell complete.  For a complete $N$-point cell the centred endpoint and signed
edge ranks are $N-1$ and $\binom N2$, while
$C_1(K_N)=u_0\wedge W_N\oplus\Lambda^2W_N$.  One temporal modular direction
forces $N$ even, nonzero interference excludes $N=2$, and minimum
future-readable source innovation selects $N=4$.  Equivalently, the complete
cycle module is one oriented spatial copy only at $N=4$.  The locked Store
realizes this $A_3$ packet with faithful, orthogonal endpoint and loop
triplets.  Hence the compiler-minimal active branch has one temporal and three
spatial dimensions.  Higher even simplices require larger endpoint and edge
sources; a seven-dimensional $G_2$ cross-product quotient additionally discards
fourteen faithful cycle directions and is an enriched, nonminimal theory.
Historical recurrence remains a separate two-cut reuse audit for the old Store,
reduced to one direct recurrent root table for each accepted type; it is not an
existence premise after the conservative relational repair is adopted.

The explicit renewal--interchange regulator has also been evaluated at this
final compiler level.  Its short endpoint cylinders close on the cubic
three-torus, its physical cut margin is uniform, the private-phase count is an
exact birth--death quotient, and every primitive flip and modulated swap obeys
local detailed balance with coefficient one.  These statements strengthen its
unconditional massive Ornstein--Uhlenbeck continuum.  They do not give an
Einstein continuum: the complete point-readable local field has exponential
state complexity, the nonlinear modulation generates patterns of unbounded
radius and degree, and the locked accepted-response record does not determine
an accepted spacetime-field kernel.  Actual physical reward occurrence,
spatial endpoint data, accepted initial/terminal field Reads, and the
same-history common-action increments therefore remain named source
certificates.

The accepted-field interface is correspondingly reduced.  One stationary
accepted initial--terminal table reconstructs its kernel, both marginals, and
on the reversible idempotent branch the unique Gibbs partition projection and
free action $-\log\mu$.  A finite affinity Hodge decomposition separates the
free-action gradient from cycle circulation.  Any protected Read preserved by
an idempotent accepted projection must be constant on its partition blocks; in
particular, count projection annihilates every nonconstant spatial Fourier
mode.  For the actual completed-private dwell, convergence to the count
projection requires the interchange-to-renewal rate ratio to diverge, while
persistence of a local spatial mode on the renewal clock requires that ratio
to remain bounded.  The projection and local reaction--diffusion roles
therefore separate into a fast conservative heat clock and a slow scalar count
clock, unless the accepted update acts only on a protected microscopic factor.

The complete accepted/common-action experiment now has canonical state records
at successively stronger levels.  The likelihood-ratio quotient is the unique
coarsest history-assisted output record preserving every fine accepted/action
relative entropy; the projective experiment quotient is the unique coarsest
output admitting one class-independent decoder for all actual and comparator
rows.  Finite future saturation gives the minimum state for every reachable
update word, while simultaneous forward and reverse lumpability gives the
minimum universal Markov retract.  In continuous time the same construction is
finite Krylov closure; failure produces an exact Mori--Zwanzig memory kernel
and resolvent self-energy.  Occupation times and directed jump counts form a
finite sufficient path record, whose relative-entropy chain rule separates
visible trajectory mismatch, destination-channel mismatch, and irreversible
within-fibre motion.  For protected additive rewards a finite Feynman--Kac
matrix reconstructs the scaled cumulant generating function, the full
finite-state large-deviation rate, and the hidden tilted self-energy.  Its
Perron--Doob transform is the unique entropy-optimal Markov dynamics making an
exposed fluctuation typical, and exact tilted quotients descend to exact driven
quotients with the same decoder.  These closures are distinct: static row

\section{Introduction and proof-status discipline}
\label{sec:introduction}
% =============================================================================

The Grand Tensor is the complete positive moment object of the operationally
accessible renewal histories.  Its corrected emergence chain is
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{complete finite intervention statistics}\\
 +\text{ generated ledger and actual Read interface}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{minimal future-readable record}
 +\text{ table-native predictive algebra}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{positive causal comb and canonical support-minimal CP class}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{contextually separated finite structural shadow }\GToldX\\
 +\text{ compiler-minimal persistent relation packet}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{relationally completed Grand Tensor }\GTrelX\\
 \Downarrow\quad
 \begin{matrix}
 \text{verified source-native renewal phase}\\[-0.1em]
 \text{and verified domain-specific loadings}
 \end{matrix}
 \quad\Downarrow\\
 \text{physical loaded realization and terminal sector certificate}.
 \end{gathered}}
\]
The structural reconstruction arrows are unconditional at every finite cutoff
relative to complete old operational data.  The relational-completion arrow is
unconditional once its point-readable persistent port is explicitly adopted,
and it preserves the old process exactly; it is not a claim that the old
marginal Store table secretly contained that port.  No part of the chain says
that the complete process probability table follows from a few scalar
microscopic constants.

The generated ledger and the intrinsic operational record are not identical by
definition.  Two ledger values are identified precisely when every admitted
continuation and every actual record-conditioned response gives the same result.
The resulting quotient is the unique coarsest typed right congruence sufficient
for all futures.  When every ledger point has a physical point Read, this
quotient is discrete and all generated values remain protected.  An unread
finite decoration does not enlarge the canonical tensor; a larger provenance
record is a finite bundle over the minimum and is a tensor product only under
constant-fibre and trivialization conditions.

This order is essential.  A $C^*$-ideal quotient cannot merge two surviving
orthogonal classical projections, so record minimization is performed before
record writers generate matrix blocks.  Afterward, the contextual future ideal
performs a different minimization: it is the largest two-sided $*$-ideal
invisible in every left and right word context.  The three objects
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{minimal readable record}\quad\neq\quad
 \text{minimal linear predictor}\\
 \neq\quad\text{minimal separated $C^*$-history envelope}
 \end{gathered}}
\]
are therefore distinct and separately canonical.

At the scalar-table level, the operational response spaces give a direct
forward executable algebra.  A scalar table alone does not select a Hilbert
adjoint: different faithful metrics can turn the same forward transition into
inequivalent $C^*$-closures.  Positivity and causal consistency reconstruct the
comb, and its canonical square-root support supplies the support-minimal CP
class whose Hilbert--Schmidt adjoints define the structural history algebra.
Arbitrary nonminimal positive realizations must be support reduced first;
otherwise their ambient adjoints can manufacture spectator histories absent
from the process.

Cutoff functoriality is likewise layered.  Exact compression of every causal
prefix produces canonical polar support isometries and strict sequential
intertwiners.  Inserting the old support projection after every letter gives an
unconditional absorbing-corner copy of the old history algebra inside every
larger cutoff.  Removing those projections requires a zero adjoint-inflow defect
and preservation of a finite flat relation list.  Newly admitted futures commute
with the old contextual quotient exactly when the contextual innovation Gram
vanishes.  Intrinsic regular traces transport by a positive central density;
physical Gram isometry is a separate metrological statement.

The infinite-horizon boundary is explicit.  Part~I-B starts from one complete
global cylinder law and derives the raw cutoff functor, cylinder state, and
strict or innovation-bearing descent of records, predictors, contextual
quotients, and mixed sources.  It then treats exact, summably correctable, and
projectively nonunique state families; constructs affine renormalization
cocycles and metric-obstruction profiles; and passes changing-domain quadratic
forms by Mosco, resolvent, semigroup, and compact-screen criteria.  Part~I-C
adds source saturation, intrinsic interaction hypergraphs, canonical collars,
feedback-Hankel memory classification, field tightness, soft-mode extraction,
and determining-panel nontriviality.  Their synthesis is an unconditional
limit-or-obstruction alternative, while the positive physical-continuum branch
still requires the declared domain margins to pass.

The concrete renewal source has three entrances which must be kept separate:
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{operational entrance: exposed branch-conditioned table and Reads},\\
 \text{selected Store entrance: calibrated completed-private opportunity instrument},\\
 \text{austere primitive entrance: regenerative rules before the Read interface}.
 \end{gathered}}
\]
The shared-edge primitive already supplies the exact two-state active renewal,
its nongeometric waiting law, fresh endpoint, strict horizon transport, and
active no-routing theorem.  The selected Store--Read interface additionally
contains the sparse accepted-response clock and locked twenty-five-cell
opportunity record.  Identifying the latter edge/order/charge semantics with an
austere source is a downstream finite loading test, not a remaining scheduler
or renewal postulate.  A coarse channel alone still does not determine a fine
instrument or score basis.

There are likewise two distinct meanings of an upstream renewal law.  At a
protected primitive tick, the source probabilities are operational data and
the finite phase quotient is exact.  Deriving the values $1/5$ and $1/3$ from
an exchange or Ward principle is stronger: after internal label regularity it
requires precisely two scalar cross-fibre currents.  The existing fresh
terminal interface cannot identify the hidden dynamics which might realize
those currents, because stationary pre-writer samplers are erased before every
later cycle.  Conversely, if the corresponding delayed binary Reads or
common-action derivatives are added, the weight test terminates.  At physical
time the negative transient eigenvalue of the protected-tick transfer forbids
a deterministic Markov embedding; the canonical positive lift is instead a
Poisson uniformization.  This distinction prevents a discretization gauge
from being promoted to an intrinsic microscopic clock.

The phrase ``three spatial dimensions'' is subject to the same discipline.
The locked $K_4$ label packet is a downstream physical loading of the renewal
source, but the dimension claim is not obtained by naming those labels as
space.  It is obtained only after the future-minimal source--target relation,
physical reversal, unordered-pair exchange, faithful endpoint and cycle
sources, and compiler-minimal source innovation have been evaluated.  On that
branch the unique minimum is $K_4/A_3$, and the independent physical clock
then gives $3+1$.  Arbitrary higher-arity, relation-coloured, nonfaithful, or
purposefully enriched loadings are outside that conclusion.


The phrase ``austere primitive'' is now used in a quotient-theoretic sense.
Given any finite microscopic lift, the complete visible word table canonically
separates the minimal active renewal quotient, every source-reachable hidden
direction which is permanently future sealed, and the quotient of directions
which can return to an active future.  Exact renewal makes the last quotient
zero.  A sealed sector is retained only relative to an actual passive Read or
another physical constraint; otherwise its dimension, dynamics, and symmetry
can be altered without changing the process.  Thus the universal object below
renewal is a canonical operational floor, not a unique maximal hidden
substrate.

The protected chronology used by arithmetic is an actual point-readable
subchain of the operational record.  Its successor, anchor, orientation, and
endpoint writers are fixed before arithmetic semantics, and the normalized
Peano relations have a singleton solution fibre.  Thus arithmetic is not
selected from an unmarked copy of $M_X(\C)$.

The pairwise block $B_X^*G_XB_X$ remains only a degree-one physical shadow of
the full word algebra.  Multiplication and involution are fixed by stabilized
word relations, not by pairwise moments.  Direct physical fringes are measured
when needed and never inferred from diagonal CP branches.

The word ``duality'' has often been used for mathematically different
comparisons.  The paper therefore fixes both a proof-status discipline and a
structure-preservation hierarchy before stating the master theorem.

\begin{definition}[Four proof statuses]
Every substantial conclusion belongs to one of the following classes.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(S\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item \emph{proved here}: a complete proof is included in this manuscript;
\item \emph{finite sector theorem}: a finite conclusion is proved from an
      explicitly displayed sector packet;
\item \emph{conditional bridge}: the implication is proved once a named
      comparison, coercivity, continuum, or resource certificate is supplied;
\item \emph{open certificate}: the named certificate is not supplied by the
      common architecture.
\end{enumerate}
A formal selector identity is never promoted to a problem-level theorem unless
its loading, comparison, and quantitative estimate are also established.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Seven levels of duality]
A comparison between two finite or regulated sectors may preserve successively
stronger structures.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(D\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item \emph{source duality}: pairwise source Grams and linear transfer moments;
\item \emph{transform duality}: an invertible Fourier, Mellin, Peter--Weyl,
      character, or spectral transform;
\item \emph{monoidal duality}: unit, involution, multiplication or fusion,
      tensoring, and all stabilized word Grams;
\item \emph{symmetry duality}: coproduct, intertwiners, projective multiplier,
      and a physical fibre functor;
\item \emph{chain duality}: grading, differential, cohomology, Hodge operator,
      determinant line, and torsion;
\item \emph{coercive duality}: positive cones, norms, resolvent bounds,
      singular values, gaps, and quantitative constants;
\item \emph{regulator/resource duality}: locality, scale, derivative or gate
      cost, sparse composition, and uniform control along a growing family.
\end{enumerate}
Only the structures actually preserved by a comparison may be transported.
\end{definition}


\begin{principle}[Source, coherence, and transport completeness]
\label{prin:GT-coherence-completeness}
For a physical source family, the following properties are logically distinct:
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{source-kernel completeness}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{record sufficiency}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{word/monoidal completeness}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{transport incidence and quantitative domination}\\
 \Downarrow\\
 \text{causal or variational selection}.
 \end{gathered}}
 \tag{CL.0}
\]
The arrows display the order of the audit, not automatic implications.  A
complete pairwise Gram fixes linear source orientation but not multiplication;
a source-sufficient record need not carry a physical connection; range
incidence need not give a regulator-uniform metric floor; and a positive action
need not select a circulating or flat signed mode.  Every failed arrow is
retained as a positive innovation, a signed current, a holonomy class, an
inertia witness, or a boundary source.
\end{principle}

\begin{definition}[Native closure classes and operational closure profile]
\label{def:GT-native-closure-profile}
A loaded finite or regulated sector is assigned the native closure type
$\tau_X$ determined by its actual terminal calculus:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(C\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item a \emph{positive interior} action or transfer after the declared physical
      shorts;
\item a \emph{protected angle} or signed endpoint pairing after an independently
      fixed predictor short;
\item a \emph{signed action/open-current} packet whose closure is a positive
      common action together with a physical boundary current;
\item an \emph{ordered boundary} packet, such as a min-plus or least-cost
      descent, for which Hilbert-space coercivity is not the native order;
\item an \emph{unloaded} packet whose source, object, action, boundary, or
      comparison row has not yet been physically constructed.
\end{enumerate}
For an audit-ready packet define
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathfrak P_X^{\rm cl}
 =\bigl(
 \tau_X,g_{{\rm obs},X},m_{{\rm cl},X},b_{{\rm resp},X},
 \alpha_X,\beta_X,Z_X,\mathfrak J_{\partial,X},
 \mathbf U_X,\mathbb C_X
 \bigr).}
 \tag{CL.1}
\]
Here $g_{\rm obs}$ is the least physical support grade of the terminal
observable, $m_{\rm cl}$ is the least primitive interaction order of an
admissible closure realization, $b_{\rm resp}$ is the minimum response-seed
dimension when a physical response exists, $\alpha_X$ is the source-frame or
observability margin, $\beta_X$ is the native local coercive or angle margin,
$Z_X$ is the exceptional screen, $\mathfrak J_{\partial,X}$ is the open
boundary term, $\mathbf U_X$ records unbounded depth, scale, volume, height, or
field directions, and $\mathbb C_X\succeq0$ is the physical source-completeness
residual.  An inapplicable coordinate is left undefined rather than set to
zero.
\end{definition}


\begin{definition}[Structured source--coherence residual]
\label{def:GT-source-coherence-profile}
The source-completeness coordinate in \textup{(CL.1)} is resolved, whenever the
corresponding physical panels exist, into
\[
 \boxed{
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb C}_X
 =\bigl(
 \mathbb C_X^{\rm ker},
 \mathbb C_X^{\rm rec},
 \mathbb C_X^{\rm mon},
 \mathbb C_X^{\rm tr},
 \mathbb C_X^{\rm ph}
 \bigr).}
 \tag{CL.1a}
\]
Here $\mathbb C^{\rm ker}$ is the missing cross-record source-kernel block,
$\mathbb C^{\rm rec}$ is the source hidden inside the proposed record fibres,
$\mathbb C^{\rm mon}$ is the unit/involution/product or fusion residual,
$\mathbb C^{\rm tr}$ is the record-visible source absent from the physical
transport carrier, and $\mathbb C^{\rm ph}$ is the remaining phase, cycle, or
primitive flat-source residual.  The unresolved scalar $\mathbb C_X$ in
\textup{(CL.1)} denotes this structured packet rather than the sum of its
entries.  Vanishing of a later component is not used to erase an earlier one.
\end{definition}

\begin{principle}[Upstream closure discipline]
\label{prin:GT-upstream-closure}
The closure audit is ordered as follows:
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{physical loading}
 \longrightarrow\text{complete assembly}
 \longrightarrow\text{source-kernel and record completeness}\\
 \longrightarrow\text{word/coherence and transport incidence}
 \longrightarrow\text{native localizer}\\
 \longrightarrow\text{screen/boundary control}
 \longrightarrow\text{regulator transport and independent selection}
 \end{gathered}}
 \tag{CL.2}
\]
The first unclosed arrow is the upstream obstruction.  A theorem at a later
arrow cannot repair an earlier defect: a stronger gap does not create an
unloaded source, local reweighting does not populate a missing mixed row, a
pairwise Gram does not reconstruct multiplication, a source overlap does not
create physical transport, a finite screen does not prove cutoff tightness,
and a fitted compatibility row is not an independent selector.
\end{principle}

\section{Conservative relational completion and the revised Grand-Tensor convention}
\label{sec:relational-completion}
% =============================================================================

The finite structural object reconstructed from an operational cylinder is
canonical, but it is not by itself a persistent inter-event relation.  In
particular, the marginal Store cylinder can preserve every old renewal
probability while differing in its global endpoint atlas, its terminal-to-next-
source carry, or its accepted field and action law.  These conservative
countermodels do not invalidate the structural reconstruction.  They show that
a physically complete spacetime-capable primitive must retain one additional
future-readable relation record.  The following definition adopts that
minimal conservative repair as part of the object called the Renewal Grand
Tensor.

\begin{definition}[Compiler-minimal persistent relation packet]
\label{def:relational-port-monograph}
Fix a cutoff $X$ and let $\mathscr O_X$ be the old resolved Store outcome
alphabet.  A raw relational event is a point-readable tuple
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathfrak p_{X,n}
 =\bigl(Z_{X,n},\Gamma_{X,n},O_{X,n},\Xi_{X,n},Z_{X,n+1}\bigr).}
 \tag{RC.1}
\]
Its entries have the following operational meanings.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(R\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item $Z_{X,n}$ is the recurrent relational state presented at the source cut.
      It contains the persistent spatial base and the future-readable
      field/action fibre, but no product decomposition of these two pieces is
      assumed.
\item $O_{X,n}\in\mathscr O_X$ is the old Store outcome.  On an accepted
      branch its locked oriented $A_3$ root is reused; no second direction
      alphabet is introduced.
\item $\Gamma_{X,n}$ is the scheduler-separated fast root path between two
      slow cuts, including the directed root winners, waiting times,
      occupation statistics, and the speed or volume calibration needed by a
      geometric loading.
\item $\Xi_{X,n}$ contains the remaining same-history marks used by the
      declared compilers: initial and terminal determining-field Reads,
      update and reverse labels, nuisance and provenance, protected rewards,
      reference and observed slow rows, and any physical boundary record.
\item $Z_{X,n+1}$ is the target relational state and is the source state of the
      next event.
\end{enumerate}
Two raw states are identified exactly when every admitted continuation,
compiler query, future mark cylinder, and terminal Read has the same
conditional law from the two states.  The resulting finite right-congruence
quotient is denoted
\[
 \boxed{\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}.}
 \tag{RC.2}
\]
It is called the compiler-minimal persistent relation packet.  Coordinates
which are deterministic functions of this quotient, including a derived
metric, coframe, connection, curvature, action comparator, or modulation
variable, are not independent primitive coordinates.
\end{definition}

Let $\{\Phi_{o,*}:o\in\mathscr O_X\}$ be the old Schr\"odinger-picture Store
instrument.  For a finite relational kernel
\[
 K_{X,o}(\gamma,\xi,z'\mid z)\ge0,
 \qquad
 \sum_{\gamma,\xi,z'}K_{X,o}(\gamma,\xi,z'\mid z)=1,
\]
define the refined branches on block states $\rho=(\rho_z)_z$ by
\[
 \boxed{
 [\widetilde\Phi_{o,\gamma,\xi,*}(\rho)]_{z'}
 :=\sum_zK_{X,o}(\gamma,\xi,z'\mid z)\Phi_{o,*}(\rho_z).}
 \tag{RC.3}
\]

\begin{definition}[Repaired process and relational Renewal Grand Tensor]
\label{def:relational-grand-tensor}
The conservative relational completion of the old process is denoted
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathsf P_X^{\rm rel}
 :=\mathsf P_X^{\rm old}\ltimes\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}.}
 \tag{RC.4}
\]
The symbol $\ltimes$ means the same-history conditional extension
\textup{(RC.3)}; it does not assert probabilistic independence or a tensor
factorization of the state space.

Apply the record minimization, Hankel reconstruction, support-minimal CP
completion, contextual history quotient, and regular-trace word-Gram
construction of Part~I to $\mathsf P_X^{\rm rel}$.  The resulting object is
\[
 \boxed{
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm rel}
 :=\left(
   \mathcal A_{X,{\rm rel}}^{\rm hist},
   \{\mathbb K_{X,r}^{\rm rel}\}_{r\ge0},
   \mathfrak R_{X,{\rm rel}}^{\min}
 \right).}
 \tag{RC.5}
\]
For a cutoff family, the definition additionally retains the physically
measured old--detail polarization tables of
\Cref{def:relational-refinement-profile}.  The structural tensor reconstructed
from $\mathsf P_X^{\rm old}$ alone is denoted
$\boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm old}$ and is the canonical forgetful
shadow of \textup{(RC.5)}.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Conservativity, future minimality, and universality]
\label{thm:relational-completion}
The relational completion has the following exact properties.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(C\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item The branches \textup{(RC.3)} are completely positive and form a
      normalized refinement of the old instrument.
\item For the forgetful map
      $\mathsf F_X(\rho)=\sum_z\rho_z$,
      \[
       \boxed{
       \mathsf F_X\!\left(
         \sum_{\gamma,\xi}\widetilde\Phi_{o,\gamma,\xi,*}(\rho)
       \right)
       =\Phi_{o,*}(\mathsf F_X\rho).}
       \tag{RC.6}
      \]
      Hence forgetting the relation packet recovers every old finite Store
      cylinder, branch probability, payload map, completion law, accepted
      count, and old duration marginal exactly.
\item Future-signature partition refinement terminates at
      $\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}$, and every other finite persistent record
      sufficient for the same compiler family has a unique surjection onto it.
      Unread refinements therefore add neither classical nor source dimension.
\item The forgetful map induces a canonical process morphism
      \[
       \boxed{
       \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm rel}
       \longrightarrow
       \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm old}}
       \tag{RC.7}
      \]
      whose image contains the complete old history algebra and old word-Gram
      hierarchy.  The old tensor is consequently a quotient or absorbing
      corner of the revised tensor, not a competing definition.
\item If all coordinates in \textup{(RC.1)} are jointly point readable, one
      downstream thinning family reconstructs every within-sector and mixed
      source block as a covariance matrix.  Orthogonal projection onto the
      nuisance sigma-algebra is exactly simultaneous Anderson--Trapp shorting.
      In particular, edge routers, efficient kinetic tensors, reward
      innovations, and accepted/action cross blocks are outputs of one joint
      event law rather than independent relative orientations.
\end{enumerate}
The construction is unique up to the source-fixing, record-preserving unitary
already present in the support-minimal Grand-Tensor theorem.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Complete positivity of \textup{(RC.3)} follows because each target block is a
nonnegative scalar combination of old CP maps.  Summing the kernel over
$(\gamma,\xi,z')$ gives one, which proves \textup{(RC.6)}.  Induction on word
length gives preservation of every old cylinder.

The future-equivalence relation is a typed right congruence: prefixing one
primitive branch to two identical future signatures leaves the signatures
identical.  Finite partition refinement terminates because every strict round
increases the number of classes.  Its stable quotient has the stated universal
property by the same fibre argument as \Cref{thm:minimal-record}.  Applying the
finite comb, history-algebra, and contextual-quotient constructions to the
refined process gives \textup{(RC.7)} by functoriality of operational coarse
graining and \Cref{thm:cutoff-compatibility}.

For the last assertion, append a readable keep bit with exponential acceptance
weight in any finite family of point Reads.  Differentiation at the neutral
setting gives their centred score vectors; the complete Fisher block is their
joint covariance.  Conditional expectation onto nuisance Reads is the
orthogonal projection in $L^2$ and therefore gives exactly the Moore--Penrose
Schur short.  Source-minimal uniqueness is then
\Cref{thm:joint-source-universality}.
\end{proof}

\begin{firewall}[Meaning of the repaired definition]
\label{fire:relational-semidir}
The relational completion is an explicit conservative modification of the
primitive.  It is not inferred from the old marginal Store table, and its
existence does not make historical terminal reuse automatic.  Conversely, once
the repaired primitive is adopted, historical reconstruction of the port is a
reuse question rather than a premise of spacetime or coupled-action existence.
\end{firewall}

\begin{assessment}[Notation convention for the remainder of the manuscript]
\label{assess:relational-notation}
The structural construction stated in \Cref{def:grand-tensor} is retained
without a global notational rewrite.  It should now be read as
$\boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm old}$ whenever only the original Store
cylinder is present.  From this section onward, the unqualified phrase
\emph{Renewal Grand Tensor} denotes the relationally completed object
$\boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm rel}$ of \textup{(RC.5)}, unless the
text explicitly says ``old'', ``structural shadow'', or names a further domain
loading.  All earlier structural theorems remain valid because the old tensor
is recovered by \textup{(RC.7)}.  Thus the revised definition is
\[
 \boxed{
 \text{Renewal Grand Tensor}
 =\mathsf P^{\rm old}
  +\text{ its compiler-minimal persistent relation packet},}
 \tag{RC.8}
\]
where the plus sign is implemented by the conservative same-history extension
\textup{(RC.3)} rather than by a direct sum.
\end{assessment}

\subsection{Scheduler separation and the geometric output of the relation port}
\label{subsec:relational-scheduler}
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

The locked Store already contains the integral $A_3$ root alphabet.  What was
missing from the old structural shadow was a persistent state on which those
roots act and a physical clock fast enough to produce a nondegenerate kinetic
bracket.  Alphabet identification and scheduler identification are therefore
separate claims.

\begin{theorem}[Old root alphabet, independent fast scheduler, and complete ADM frame]
\label{thm:relational-scheduler-ADM}
Let $r_1,\ldots,r_6$ be the six unoriented $A_3$ root classes in an anchored
integral basis,
\[
 r_1=e_1,\quad r_2=e_2,\quad r_3=e_3,\quad
 r_4=e_2-e_1,\quad r_5=e_3-e_1,\quad r_6=e_3-e_2.
 \tag{RC.9}
\]
For directed rates $k_a^\pm$ and mesh $h$, define
\[
 \mathcal B_h
 =h^2\sum_{a=1}^{6}(k_a^++k_a^-)r_ar_a^{\mathsf T},
 \qquad
 \beta_h
 =h\sum_{a=1}^{6}(k_a^+-k_a^-)r_a.
 \tag{RC.10}
\]
Then:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(A\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item the six matrices $r_ar_a^{\mathsf T}$ form a basis of
      $\operatorname{Sym}_3$;
\item the six directed-rate differences have rank three onto $\beta_h$, and
      their three-dimensional kernel is the tetrahedral circulation space;
\item observing the winning root together with its waiting time gives a
      faithful score frame for all directed rates; discarding the waiting time
      loses the common rate scale;
\item with positive speed density $\varrho_h$, the analytic formulas
      \[
       \boxed{
       g_h=\varrho_h^{2/3}(\det\mathcal B_h)^{1/3}\mathcal B_h^{-1},
       \qquad
       N_h=\varrho_h^{1/3}(\det\mathcal B_h)^{1/6}}
       \tag{RC.11}
      \]
      reconstruct the six spatial metric components and lapse, while
      $\beta_h$ gives the three shift components;
\item an $h$-mesh bracket satisfying $\mathcal B_h\succeq cI_3$ requires total
      fast rate $\sum_a(k_a^++k_a^-)\ge c' h^{-2}$.  A clock of intensity
      $O(h^{-1})$, including the old renewal or accepted clock under its natural
      scaling, produces a bracket $O(h)$ and collapses.
\end{enumerate}
Thus the old root labels may be reused exactly, but the geometric scheduler
must be the scheduler-separated fast path $\Gamma_{X,n}$ of
\Cref{def:relational-port-monograph}.  No metric, coframe, connection, or
Einstein tensor is primitive data.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The three coordinate rank-one matrices give the diagonal entries of a
symmetric matrix.  Subtracting them from
$(e_j-e_i)(e_j-e_i)^{\mathsf T}$ gives the three independent off-diagonal
entries, proving item~\textup{(A1)}.  The roots span $\R^3$, so the difference
map in \textup{(RC.10)} has rank three; its kernel has dimension three and is
the cycle-current space of the tetrahedral edge graph.

For an exponential race with rates $k_b$, the log-rate score of one winner and
waiting time is
$s_b=\mathbf1_{\{A=b\}}-k_bT$.  Direct integration gives
$\mathbb E[s_bs_c]=\delta_{bc}k_b/(\sum_jk_j)$, which is faithful.  Winner
probabilities alone have covariance $\operatorname{diag}(p)-pp^{\mathsf T}$
and lose the common scale.  Formula \textup{(RC.11)} is inverted by
$\varrho_h=\sqrt{\det g_h}$ and
$\mathcal B_h=N_h^2g_h^{-1}$, so it is an analytic bijection on the positive
cone.

Finally, if $\|r_a\|\le R$, then
$\operatorname{tr}\mathcal B_h\le
 R^2h^2\sum_a(k_a^++k_a^-)$.  The lower bound
$\mathcal B_h\succeq cI_3$ makes the left side at least $3c$, proving the
$h^{-2}$ scheduler bound.  An $O(h^{-1})$ clock therefore gives a vanishing
bracket.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Bounded local relation audit]
\label{cor:relational-depth-four}
On the free additive $A_3$ accumulator, every equality of two root words with
the same endpoint is generated by translated copies of three relation types:
\[
 \boxed{
 \gamma(-\gamma),\qquad
 (e_j-e_i)e_i(-e_j),\qquad
 e_ie_j(-e_i)(-e_j).}
 \tag{RC.12}
\]
Their lengths are respectively two, three, and four.  Consequently every local
router, action-cochain, and flatness comparison is decided by same-history
cylinders of depth at most four.  Compact topology contributes only the
additional finite deck-period bank and cannot be inferred from bounded local
cylinders.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
The inverse relations remove adjacent inverse letters.  The triangle relations
express every nonbasis $A_3$ root as a difference of two basis roots.  The
commutator squares make the three basis translations commute.  The resulting
presentation is the free abelian group $\Z^3$, so two words have the same
endpoint exactly when their quotient lies in the normal closure of the
relations in \textup{(RC.12)}.  A compact quotient adds precisely its period
subgroup.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Explicit conservative flat-vacuum branch]
\label{cor:relational-flat-vacuum}
Realize $\Lambda_{A_3}$ in its standard Euclidean three-dimensional space
$W_0$, let $V_d=\Lambda_{A_3}/d\Lambda_{A_3}$ and $h=d^{-1}$, and give each of
the twelve oriented roots rate $1/(8h^2)$ and every vertex mass $h^3$.  Take one point in
the field fibre, the identity router, zero nonvacuum cost, and the identity slow
row.  Then:
\[
 \boxed{\mathcal B_h=I_3,\qquad\varrho_h=1,
        \qquad g_h=I_3,\quad N_h=1,\quad\beta_h=0,}
 \tag{RC.13}
\]
every undirected root-edge conductance is $h/8$, the periodic cut margin is
uniformly positive, all depth-four router and action residuals vanish, and
forgetting the port recovers the old Store cylinder exactly.  Along any cofinal
scalar-period sequence, the spatial generators converge to
$\tfrac12\Delta_{\mathbb T^3}$ and the Lorentzian limit is
\[
 \boxed{(\R\times\mathbb T^3,-\dd t^2+\dd x_1^2+\dd x_2^2+\dd x_3^2),}
 \tag{RC.14}
\]
which satisfies the vacuum Einstein equation.  Thus the positive spacetime
branch of the repaired primitive is nonempty without inserting a metric or an
Einstein equation.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
For the chosen normalization the twelve-root identity is
$\sum_{\alpha\in\Phi_{A_3}}\alpha\alpha^{\mathsf T}=8I_3$; substituting the
rates gives \textup{(RC.13)}.  Reversal symmetry gives zero shift, and
\textup{(RC.11)} gives the ADM packet.  Multiplying the rate by the vertex mass
gives conductance $h/8$; the periodic three-dimensional cut estimate is then
uniform.  The constant coframe and identity router have zero torsion and
curvature, and the periodic regulator has no external spatial boundary, so the
finite vacuum action and its first variation vanish.  Fourier expansion gives
symbol
$h^{-2}\sum_a[1-\cos(2\pi h r_a\cdot k)]/4$, which converges to
$2\pi^2|k|^2$, proving the semigroup and metric limit.  Conservativity is
\Cref{thm:relational-completion}.
\end{proof}


\begin{theorem}[Explicit conservative homogeneous curved-vacuum branch]
\label{thm:relational-deSitter-branch}
Fix $H>0$ and retain the scalar-period carrier and the twelve oriented root
branches of \Cref{cor:relational-flat-vacuum}.  At physical time $t$, give each
oriented root the rate
\[
 \boxed{k_{\alpha,h}(t)=\frac{e^{-2Ht}}{8h^2}}
 \tag{RC.15a}
\]
and every vertex the mass
\[
 \boxed{m_h(t)=e^{3Ht}h^3.}
 \tag{RC.15b}
\]
Take one point in the matter fibre, trivial deck and projective sectors, and a
one-target slow geometry row.  Then:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(D\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item the predictable bracket, speed density, and ADM variables are
      \[
       \boxed{
       \mathcal B_h(t)=e^{-2Ht}I_3,
       \qquad \varrho_h(t)=e^{3Ht},
       \qquad g_h(t)=e^{2Ht}I_3,
       \quad N_h(t)=1,
       \quad\beta_h(t)=0;}
       \tag{RC.15c}
      \]
\item every undirected root-edge conductance is
      \[
       \boxed{u_{e,h}(t)=\frac{e^{Ht}}8h,}
       \tag{RC.15d}
      \]
      and on every compact time slab $|t|\le T$ the cut, Poincar\'e,
      $R^{3/2}$ counting, and compact-screen constants have one positive lower
      bound independent of $h$;
\item the continuum coframe
      \[
       \vartheta^0=\dd t,
       \qquad
       \vartheta^a=e^{Ht}\dd x^a
      \]
      with connection
      $\omega^a{}_0=H\vartheta^a$, $\omega^a{}_b=0$ is torsion free and has
      constant sectional curvature $H^2$;
\item with cosmological coefficient
      \[
       \boxed{\Lambda_{\rm cos}=3H^2,}
       \tag{RC.15e}
      \]
      the limiting Lorentzian metric
      \[
       \boxed{
       \mathbf g_H=-\dd t^2+e^{2Ht}
       (\dd x_1^2+\dd x_2^2+\dd x_3^2)}
       \tag{RC.15f}
      \]
      satisfies
      $G_{\mu\nu}+\Lambda_{\rm cos}(\mathbf g_H)_{\mu\nu}=0$;
\item on the explicit nested sequence
      $h_n=2^{-n^2}$ with time mesh $h_n$ and screen $[-n,n]$, exact
      parallel transport of the reconstructed Levi--Civita connection gives
      metric-unitary links, while the normalized torsion, plaquette-curvature,
      and Palatini first-variation defects are $O_T(h_n)$ on every compact
      slab and are summable along the diagonal exhaustion;
\item forgetting the curved port recovers every old Store cylinder exactly.
\end{enumerate}
Consequently the relationally repaired primitive has a genuinely curved,
nondegenerate, globally hyperbolic vacuum realization.  The metric in
\textup{(RC.15f)} is the compact spatial quotient of the flat de~Sitter
slicing; geodesic completion to the global hyperboloid is a stronger optional
global construction.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The twelve-root identity used in
\Cref{cor:relational-flat-vacuum} gives
$\mathcal B_h(t)=e^{-2Ht}I_3$.  Substitution in \textup{(RC.11)} with
$\varrho_h=e^{3Ht}$ gives \textup{(RC.15c)}.  Multiplying one directed rate by
the vertex mass gives \textup{(RC.15d)}.  On $[-T,T]$ the factor $e^{Ht}$ is
bounded above and below, so the periodic cut estimate and all consequences of
the protected spatial-screen theorem remain uniform.

Since $\dd\vartheta^a=H\vartheta^0\wedge\vartheta^a$, Cartan's first equation
vanishes for the displayed connection.  Cartan's second equation gives
$\Omega^{A}{}_{B}=H^2\vartheta^A\wedge\vartheta_B$ and hence
$R_{\mu\nu}=3H^2\mathbf g_{\mu\nu}$ and $R=12H^2$, proving the Einstein
equation.  Smooth Taylor expansion of exact link parallel transports gives a
face holonomy
$\log U_{\partial p}=-|p|\Omega_p+O_T(h_n^3)$ and an integrated torsion
remainder $O_T(h_n^3)$.  Division by face area yields the $O_T(h_n)$
defects.  Midpoint quadrature gives the same order for the finite
Palatini--Holst plus cosmological first variation.  The choice
$h_n=2^{-n^2}$ makes $\sum_ne^{Cn}h_n<\infty$ for every fixed $C$.
Conservativity follows from \Cref{thm:relational-completion} because the
curved port propagator is trace preserving.
\end{proof}

\begin{assessment}[Realization status of the repaired spacetime branch]
The old marginal Store tensor still does not determine a persistent endpoint,
a fast geometric clock, or a global period law.  Once the compiler-minimal
relational repair is adopted, however, spacetime existence is no longer merely
a certification alternative: \Cref{cor:relational-flat-vacuum} and
\Cref{thm:relational-deSitter-branch} give explicit flat and curved cofinal
vacuum realizations.  Historical terminal reuse remains a separate economy
audit and is not an existence premise.
\end{assessment}

\subsection{Refinement polarization and the relational cutoff packet}
\label{subsec:relational-refinement}
% -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

\begin{definition}[Paired old--detail refinement profile]
\label{def:relational-refinement-profile}
For adjacent cutoffs $X<Y$, decompose the source-minimal fine carrier as
\[
 \mathcal H_Y=J_{Y/X}\mathcal H_X\oplus K_{Y/X}\mathcal D_{Y/X}.
\]
Let the physical positive form $M_Y=I+L_Y$ have polarization block
\[
 \boxed{
 M_Y=\begin{pmatrix}A_{Y/X}&B_{Y/X}\\
                     B_{Y/X}^*&D_{Y/X}\end{pmatrix}.}
 \tag{RC.15}
\]
On the supported detail space put
\[
 S_{Y/X}=A_{Y/X}-B_{Y/X}D_{Y/X}^{\dagger}B_{Y/X}^*,
 \tag{RC.16}
\]
\[
 \boxed{
 \sigma_{Y/X}=\|S_{Y/X}-M_X\|_{\op},\quad
 \mu_{Y/X}=\lambda_{\min}^{+}(D_{Y/X}),\quad
 \theta_{Y/X}=\|B_{Y/X}D_{Y/X}^{\dagger}\|_{\op}.}
 \tag{RC.17}
\]
The table \textup{(RC.15)}, reconstructed by finite polarization on old,
detail, and mixed probes, is the refinement component of the revised
Grand-Tensor cutoff system.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Exact harmonic lift and common-screen handoff]
\label{thm:relational-refinement-handoff}
Assume the range condition required for \textup{(RC.16)}.  The map
\[
 \boxed{
 \mathcal H_{Y/X}u
 =J_{Y/X}u-K_{Y/X}D_{Y/X}^{\dagger}B_{Y/X}^*u}
 \tag{RC.18}
\]
minimizes the fine energy over all detail completions and satisfies
\[
 \boxed{
 \langle\mathcal H_{Y/X}u,M_Y\mathcal H_{Y/X}u\rangle
 =\langle u,S_{Y/X}u\rangle.}
 \tag{RC.19}
\]
Thus $\sigma_{Y/X}=0$ is exact effective old-sector transport.  If along a
cofinal sequence
\[
 \sum_X\left(\sigma_X+\theta_X+\mu_X^{-1}\right)<\infty,
 \tag{RC.20}
\]
then the relational forms, resolvents, regular low-energy spectral projections,
Hodge complexes, traces, and every fixed finite internal-rank loading have the
same canonical common-screen limit furnished by Part~I-B.  A failed condition
returns respectively an old-sector Schur mismatch, a leakage direction, or a
finite detail soft mode.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Complete the square in \textup{(RC.15)} on the supported detail range.  The
minimizer is \textup{(RC.18)} and the remaining old quadratic form is the Schur
complement \textup{(RC.16)}, proving \textup{(RC.19)}.  Summability in
\textup{(RC.20)} is precisely the summable form/resolvent compatibility profile
used in
\Cref{thm:summable-metric-correction,thm:GT-Mosco,thm:compact-screen-alternative}.
Tensoring a fixed finite internal carrier multiplies screen ranks by its fixed
dimension and does not alter the summability powers.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Boundary-complete relational refinement]
\label{cor:relational-boundary-complete-refinement}
In the setting of \Cref{def:relational-refinement-profile}, suppose the fine
cutoff also carries a physical boundary map
\[
 \mathcal D_{Y/X}=(D_{X,Y}\;D_{\rm det,Y})
 :J_{Y/X}\mathcal H_X\oplus K_{Y/X}\mathcal D_{Y/X}
 \longrightarrow\mathcal B_{Y/X}.
\]
Put
\[
 E_{Y/X}
 =D_{X,Y}-D_{\rm det,Y}D_{Y/X}^{\dagger}B_{Y/X}^*,
 \qquad
 K_{Y/X}^{\partial}
 =D_{\rm det,Y}D_{Y/X}^{\dagger}D_{\rm det,Y}^*.
\]
After separating the detail kernel into the exceptional screen, the exact
boundary-complete effective old action is
\[
 \boxed{
 S_{Y/X}^{\partial}
 =S_{Y/X}
 +E_{Y/X}^*(I+K_{Y/X}^{\partial})^{-1}E_{Y/X}.}
 \tag{RC.21}
\]
Hence refinement transport of the complete closure packet requires only the
three effective rows
$(S_{Y/X},E_{Y/X},K_{Y/X}^{\partial})$; identifying arbitrary detail bases
between cutoffs is unnecessary.  Shorting before the boundary is assembled
loses exactly the positive dispersion of
\Cref{cor:GT-boundary-relaxation-dispersion}.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply \Cref{thm:GT-boundary-complete-short} to the old/detail polarization
\textup{(RC.15)} and the displayed boundary map.  The asserted data reduction
is immediate from the resulting formula.
\end{proof}

\begin{assessment}[Revised universal boundary]
The old Store process remains an exact, canonical structural shadow and the
countermodels separating it from global geometry remain valid.  The universal
primitive adopted by this manuscript is nevertheless no longer missing an
unspecified relation object: it is $\mathsf P^{\rm old}$ together with the
future-minimal relation packet \textup{(RC.1)} and the paired refinement table
\textup{(RC.15)}.  Domain sections should therefore test physical coefficients,
nonzero loads, global topology, and conjecture-specific estimates on this
common carrier rather than repeatedly re-admitting persistence, geometry, or
relative source orientation as unrelated primitives.
\end{assessment}



The higher-grade calculus obeys an additional order-of-operations principle.
A finite comparison of resolved laws supplies a Hellinger secant but not a
physical derivative; one-copy data supply neither a multi-copy carrier nor an
associative fusion; and a signed M\"obius interaction is not itself a positive
coercive action.  The admissible chain is therefore
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{gathered}
 \text{actual panel}\longrightarrow\text{secant source}
 \longrightarrow\text{physical tangent}\\
 \longrightarrow\text{fusion/occurrence short}
 \longrightarrow\text{effective fixed or current sector}.
 \end{gathered}}
\]
At each arrow the missing structure is represented by a positive residual or a
concrete incompatibility witness.

\begin{theorem}[Master architecture]
\label{thm:master-architecture}
Let $\mathfrak O_X$ be a bare finite intervention--renewal datum satisfying its
finite consistency tests.  Then the following statements are exact.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(M\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item The complete probability table reconstructs unique frame-independent
      positive causal prefix combs; no comb representative is supplied.
\item The generated ledger has a canonical minimum
      $\mathscr R_X^{\min}$, the unique coarsest typed right congruence sufficient
      for all admitted futures.  A terminating partition refinement reconstructs
      it, unread refinements have the same minimum, and actual point Reads remain
      distinct.
\item The record-conditioned Hankel quotient is the unique minimal linear
      predictor.  Its forward transitions directly generate the table-native
      executable algebra $\mathcal B_X^{\rm pred}$.
\item The positive comb determines a canonical square-root support-minimal
      sequential CP class, unique up to record-intertwining memory unitaries.
      The resulting history $C^*$-algebra is independent of CP frames, Kraus and
      purification coordinates, and the support-minimal representative, but not
      of arbitrary unreduced positive factorizations.
\item The process relation algebra, contextual future ideal, unique minimal
      separated history envelope, finite separating Read panel, and central
      source-ideal atlas are canonical.  Classical record minimization occurs
      before writer completion and cannot be replaced by a $C^*$-ideal quotient.
\item The normalized regular trace gives the intrinsic positive word-Gram
      hierarchy.  Finite dimensionality forces flatness, and one stabilized
      panel reconstructs the unit, involution, multiplication, minimal record
      algebra, conditional predictive core algebras, and all represented mixed
      histories.
\item Every faithful physical future metric is a positive congruence of the
      intrinsic hierarchy and has the same relations and monoidal algebra.  Its
      degree-one Store compression is $\GTX=B_X^*G_XB_X$.  Quantitative
      condition numbers and coercive constants remain metric dependent.
\item One globally consistent operational cylinder process derives exact prefix
      compression, canonical polar support isometries, the strict raw
      absorbing-corner history functor, and one cylinder state.  Minimal records,
      predictors, contextual quotients, and mixed sources either descend
      strictly or return their finite positive innovation Grams.  Prefix,
      record, context, predictor, and source incompatibility therefore have
      explicit finite witnesses.
\item The raw system has an AF structural limit and compatible local nets have a
      quasilocal completion.  Exact state families extend uniquely; summably
      incompatible states, source Grams, observables, and UCP dynamics have
      canonical corrected limits; arbitrary states have a compact projective
      cluster set with a finite separator when it is nonunique.  Every declared
      observable has a linear--affine renormalization class.  Closed forms on
      changing Hilbert spaces satisfy the exact Mosco--resolvent--semigroup
      alternative, with compact-screen spectral convergence or graph-mass
      escape.
\item Primitive-writer density removes an independent cyclicity hypothesis.
      Exact Hankel exhaustion and moment-exact leakage recover the complete
      selected transfer.  Simultaneously shorted connected panels reconstruct a

\begin{assessment}[Exact meaning of full microscopic emergence]
The canonical finite object is complete relative to the declared operational
process and its minimal readable record.  ``Full'' may additionally mean a
finer provenance ledger only when its point Reads are actual physical
operations.  The finite theorem contains every represented mixed word, its
relations, and the minimal contextually separated quotient.  At the
pre-renewal level, completeness means that every returning hidden direction
and every declared passive provenance direction has been reduced to its unique
reachable--observable quotient.  It does not mean that an unread spectator,
a preferred hidden basis, or a finest microscopic dilation has been selected.
Nor does it contain by definition an unmeasured fringe, an undeclared source,
one finite infinite-horizon memory, a downstream synchronized Store loading
not verified by its residual, or a regulator-uniform gap.  Parts~I-B and I-C
canonically construct the structural carrier and an unconditional
certification-or-obstruction profile.  They do not force the positive branch or
supply a domain's missing metric, locality scale, unbounded-field domain, or
numerical coercive margin.
\end{assessment}

\part{Canonical minimal operational emergence of the Renewal Grand Tensor}
\label{part:full-microscopic-emergence}

\begin{assessment}[Internal architecture of Part I]
Part I-A consists of the finite tomographic, record, predictive, CP, history,
source, flat-reconstruction, and renewal theorems.  It also classifies finite
pre-renewal lifts into the visible quotient, the canonical returned-feedback
quotient, and Read-relative sealed provenance, thereby replacing a preferred
hidden primitive by a canonical operational floor.  Part I-B derives strict
cutoff systems from global cylinder data, constructs exact and summably
corrected AF/quasilocal states and source limits, reconstructs renormalization
cocycles, and treats changing-domain unbounded limits by Mosco and graph-screen
methods.  Part I-C reconstructs intrinsic operational hypergraphs and collars,
classifies recurrent memory, and assembles source, metric, field, locality,
coercivity, and nontriviality profiles into the universal
certification-or-obstruction theorem.  Domain sections evaluate those profiles;
they do not redefine the universal machinery.
\end{assessment}

% =============================================================================
\section{Tomographic entrance, generated ledgers, and minimal readable records}
\label{sec:minimal-datum}
% =============================================================================

The finite emergence theorem begins from complete operational process data, not
from a hidden state space or a target algebra.  Three classical objects must be
distinguished from the outset:
\[
 \boxed{
 \begin{aligned}
  &\text{the generated ledger of facts physically written by the protocol},\\
  &\text{the smallest record actually distinguishable by admitted futures},\\
  &\text{an optional finer provenance record when all of its point Reads are physical}.
 \end{aligned}}
\]
Only the second is intrinsic without a stronger point-Read policy.  Record
minimization occurs before deterministic writers are completed to a
$C^*$-history algebra; a $C^*$-ideal quotient cannot merge two surviving
orthogonal classical points.

\begin{definition}[Bare finite intervention--renewal datum]
\label{def:bare-predictive-renewal}
At cutoff $X$, a bare finite intervention--renewal datum consists of:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(R\arabic*)},leftmargin=3em]
\item a finite typed protocol with deterministic discard, finite sequential and
      parallel composition, finite classical control, and coarse graining;
