\begin{proposition}[Master no-overstatement boundary]
\label{prop:no-overstatement}
The results of this manuscript do not imply:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\arabic*)},leftmargin=2.8em]
\item that finite structural emergence identifies an unexposed hidden
      instrument or fine score basis, proves a downstream synchronized
      edge/order/charge loading, places the process in the optional coherent
      Store--score phase, determines a physical fringe panel, places every
      independently sourced physical history in one universal ideal, or gives a
      neutral record a domain-specific meaning;
\item that finite-cutoff Hankel rank, source completeness, prefix-comb
      support, flat depth, a finite full-record carrier, pointwise tightness, or a
      pointwise physical gap, a finite Hellinger secant, or a finite spectral
      peak implies finite recurrent CP memory, a physical tangent, bounded
      infinite-horizon action, uniform observability, a noncollapsing physical
      rate, an actual character atom, or a nontrivial physical continuum
      realization; nor that a fixed
      per-cycle gap survives a shrinking physical step, that predictor
      innovation is physical dissipation without the outgoing-energy panel, or
      that independent local gaps survive a fixed-rate random-scan scheduler;
\item that the degree-one pairwise shadow, without its word hierarchy and
      complete mixed occurrence panels, determines multiplication, higher
      fusion, associators, occurrence innovations, chain differential, positive
      cone, graded action, or resource metric;
\item that the total primitive algebra is only $M_4(\C)$, or that every
      higher-arity, relation-coloured, nonfaithful, or purposefully enriched
      loading has $(3+1)$ dimensions.  What is proved is the $3+1$ conclusion
      for the future-minimal, reciprocal, pair-homogeneous, faithful and
      compiler-minimal one-source/one-target relational branch;
\item that equality of marginal, spectral, finite-transform, or regular-trace
      data proves identity of independently loaded physical sources or metrics;
\item that the finite Standard-Model seed, anomaly theorem, a formal grading
      label, or the existence of a finite commutant fixes the autonomous odd
      Store coefficient, the regulator-stable multiplicity algebra, flavour
      matrices, masses, or mixing parameters without the record, relative Howe,
      support-tail, and Hodge-screen certificates;
\item that the displayed six-state source carries a grading-changing matter
      occurrence, that typed and colour marginals select $K_{\rm rep}$, that the
      source-native occurrence residuals vanish without differentiated
      cross-support data, or that availability of the protected score-square
      fallback proves the unchanged autonomous Store executes it;
\item that ordinary unmarked transport moments determine a numerical finite
      Dirac/Yukawa operator, a physical scalar action, or a nonzero normal source;
\item that the spacetime Clifford algebra equals the Standard-Model gauge
      algebra;
\item that additive--multiplicative Fourier duality, Frobenius copies, affine
      Wilson orbits, character Parseval, or degree-one Ward cancellation supplies
      arithmetic contraction in the neutral higher tensor grades;
\item that fixed source saturation, endpoint coalescence, the Jacobi edge, or
      the pair-carry Bessel theorem proves PCJM12 or an unconditional zero-free
      strip;
\item that an exact prime/factor-depth selector, local admissibility, GRH,
      or a positive $P_1\cup P_2$ carrier proves positive fixed-gap, fixed-sum,
      or general affine prime mass without a connected neutral-tensor estimate;
\item that a finite transfer gap is already a continuum Yang--Mills mass gap;
\item that a harmonic projection produces rational algebraic cycles;
\item that a large Hilbert-space dimension gives a circuit lower bound;
\item that scalar local determinants determine matrix interface gluing; or
\item that any unresolved arithmetic, PDE, gauge, geometric, or complexity
      problem follows from universality, protected records, finite loading, or
      regulator-independent terminology alone.
\end{enumerate}
\end{proposition}

\begin{assessment}[Recommended research order]
The finite structural Grand Tensor, the renewal-native two-state process, and
the universal directed-limit, locality, coercivity, pressure-flow, and memory
frameworks are now mature.  The primitive temporal continuum is no longer the
main uncertainty: the accepted-response pressure fixes its action anchor and
the intrinsic fast phase has vanishing generator-scale feedback.  The
highest-value continuum task is now the evaluation of the actual physical
panels on one regulator family.  First construct the protected endpoint and
edge-current atlas, evaluate one pair, one triple, one four-body, one edge, and
one triangle prototype, and prove the pressure-flow cut margin through bounded
congestion, protected collars, or an integrated coordinate atlas.  This closes
the global spatial Poincar\'e and compact-screen problem.

Next place the Palatini, matter, gauge, potential, counterterm, boundary, and
duration rewards on one resolved first-return record.  Compute the reward
covariance and renewal-pressure jet, test common-action curl and periods, and
evaluate the memory short, connection Euler/spin source, exact potential and
counterterm residuals, coherent Ward Gram, and determining stationarity panel.
In parallel, audit the loaded transient spectrum and couplings: classify every
low mode as a declared field or canonical innovation, include it in the common
action, and prove decay of the high-energy Feshbach and Hankel tails.  The final
classical local target is then the $o(\tau_X)$ actual-cycle/action comparison
on those completed fields, not another abstract continuum theorem.  Once the
fine accepted/action rows are available, reconstruct first the canonical
likelihood-ratio and projective experiment records, then the future-saturated
and generator-retract states.  Only after those finite tests pass should one
compare full trajectory likelihoods, hidden entropy production, tilted Perron
spectra, and the corresponding driven rare-event dynamics.  This order avoids
using one-time row agreement as a surrogate for pathwise or long-time action
closure.

The active Standard-Model programme has crossed its first two closure
milestones.  The geometry-shorted residual, two tetrahedral controls, and one
odd root-edge seed give a finite structural SM packet; the same carrier now
supports one local gauge--Higgs--Dirac--Yukawa action with exact Ward, classical
BRST, current, stress, and cofinal classical convergence.  The highest-value
remaining task is therefore SM-III: evaluate the physical coefficient bank and
historical word-membership rows where desired, then construct the chiral
fermion measure and its determinant/Pfaffian section before addressing
counterterms, running, matching, and the interacting quantum continuum.  The
older grading, provenance, and relative-Howe panels remain essential for
historical reuse and for alternative non-active realizations, but are no longer
existence premises for the explicit active SM-I/SM-II branch.

The arithmetic joint-source programme is structurally wrapped at degree one,
but the actual-panel discipline now separates the remaining quantitative work.
For GRH, evaluate both the completed--Euler metric bridge and the integrated
hard-box fixed/coboundary leakage, together with the independent lower bridge.
For affine primes, reconstruct the degree-two occurrence panel before testing
the parity-sensitive neutral source, and obtain the first triple associator
before extrapolating to higher complexity.  In Yang--Mills, replace bare-link
smallness by a physical ultraviolet/effective-infrared Feshbach packet along the
weak-coupling trajectory.  In Navier--Stokes, build the occurrence-shorted triad
action before charging its open scale current.  In Hodge theory, short every
invariant occurrence obstruction before applying semiregularity positivity.
Chain, quantum determinant-line, and resource problems retain their named
terminal analytic or physical certificates.
\end{assessment}

\section{Conclusion}
\label{sec:conclusion}
% =============================================================================

The microscopic Renewal Grand Tensor is now organized around an
intervention-first, record-protected theorem rather than a preassembled coherent
carrier.  At each finite cutoff the primitive physical input is the typed table
of preparations, interventions, terminal Reads, and their multitime
probabilities, together with positivity, causality, normalization, and the
protocol-generated labels that later operations are allowed to read.  The
protected record contains only such independently generated operational facts.
It contains no arithmetic coefficient, metric, gauge group, particle species,
Yukawa matrix, chain equivalence, resource lower bound, or conjecture truth
value.

The predictive core is reconstructed, not supplied.  The record-conditioned
Hankel quotient is its unique minimal linear realization, and the positive
causal comb reconstructs a support-minimal sequential CP realization up to
record-fixing memory unitaries.  The complete reduced core--record word maps then
generate the process-history $C^*$-algebra.  Quotienting its contextual future
radical removes precisely the histories invisible to every admitted future,
while protected label Reads prevent distinct record values from being
identified.  Central source ideals and finite separating Read panels are
therefore consequences of the operational table rather than hidden completeness
assumptions.

The canonical structural Grand Tensor is the normalized regular-trace hierarchy
\[
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}^{\min,op}_{\Grand,X}
 =\bigl(\mathcal A_X^{\rm hist},
        \{\mathbb K^{\rm op}_{X,r}\}_{r\ge0},
        \mathfrak R_X^{\rm op}\bigr).
\]
This is the exact structural shadow
$\boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm old}$ of the original Store process.
The physically complete object adopted in this version is instead
\[
 \boxed{
 \boldsymbol{\mathbb T}_{\Grand,X}^{\rm rel}
 =\operatorname{GT}\!\left(
   \mathsf P_X^{\rm old}\ltimes\mathfrak P_X^{\rm rel,min}
 \right),}
\]
retained together with its old--detail polarization tables.  The persistent
port carries the old $A_3$ root outcome, the scheduler-separated fast path,
the same-history field/action marks, and the next relational state; forgetting
it returns the structural shadow exactly.  Its Gram kernel is exactly the
word-relation ideal.  Finite dimensionality
forces a flat depth, at which one stabilized panel reconstructs the object
units, involution, multiplication, protected record algebra, every conditional
predictive core algebra, and all represented mixed histories.  A faithful
physical future metric is a positive congruence of this intrinsic hierarchy and
therefore changes conditioning but not the reconstructed algebra.  The
Radon--Nikodym block $B_X^*G_XB_X$ is its degree-one physical Store shadow.

Direct interference has been separated from structural emergence.  Diagonal CP
histories do not determine a laboratory fringe; positive off-diagonal Choi
blocks are parameterized by contractions between the corresponding supports.
The Store--score writer and two-phase polarization formula remain exact and
useful when their coherent controls and fringe settings are physically present,
but they are optional realization data rather than axioms defining the Grand
Tensor.  Likewise, every finite CP alphabet has a derived common path/dilation
completion, while the path labels remain explicit until an actual physical
erasure or future-nullity theorem is supplied.


The same discipline now governs signed coherence.  A complete cross-record
source kernel reconstructs the linear source atlas, but the coarsest
source-sufficient record, the stabilized word algebra, and the independently
physical transport are successively stronger data.  Their exact residuals
separate source hidden inside record fibres, missing word or occurrence
coordinates, transport-incidence failure, minimum demand action, open boundary
current, and internal cycle current.  The coherent/counterflow decomposition
is performed only after the relevant nuisance and cycle shorts.  A positive
action prices a represented nonflat source but does not select a circulating
or flat orientation without a physical law.  Congruence-invariant inertia and
rank--trace estimates supply an additional population or threshold-index
certificate; they do not determine a protected phase or a canonical residual
subspace.

Beyond one cutoff, a globally consistent cylinder process now derives the
strict raw history system and its state rather than presupposing prefix-exact
arrows.  Finite record, predictor, context, and source minima descend or expose
their innovation Grams.  Exact and summably defective state, source,
observable, and dynamics families have canonical limits, while arbitrary state
families have compact projective cluster sets.  Renormalization is an affine
metric cocycle with explicit scale and support profiles, and changing-domain
unbounded operators pass by Mosco, resolvent, semigroup, and compact-screen
criteria.

Part~I-C then separates algebraic saturation from quantitative and geometric
control.  Simultaneously shorted connected panels reconstruct the intrinsic
interaction hypergraph and its operational collars; feedback is classified by
temporal tail and realization rank; field tightness, source escape, soft modes,
and determining variances complete the audit.  The mature universal theorem is
therefore an unconditional certification-or-obstruction alternative.  It
defines and detects the controlled positive continuum branch without asserting
that every domain loading satisfies its margins.

The obstruction alternative is now typed rather than summarized by one scalar
gap.  A physical packet first exposes its loading and assembly residuals; a
complete writer atlas then separates source invisibility from a visible soft
mode; the canonical threshold screen isolates the exceptional sector; and the
boundary-complete Schur form retains the exact current cost after detail
relaxation.  For cutoff shells, structural fit, future-state saturation,
invariant-tail return, held-out nesting, numerical selection, and regulator
transport are independent certificates.  The returned-tail Hankel quotient is
the minimum hidden carrier relevant to the declared retained response, while
the full physical law is retained whenever nonlinear, positivity, or other
observable rows can still see the discarded directions.

The positive branch now has a sharper spatial, variational, and memory
realization.  Canonical pressure demands identify the global three-dimensional
cut constant with a minimum-congestion current problem; the same margin yields
Sobolev and Poincar\'e coercivity, Weyl-type low-energy counting, and compact
screens.  Face- and period-closed directional histories integrate into
protected coordinate charts, while interface-capacity residuals detect
macroscopic necks.  Protected vector rewards on a marked renewal cycle define
a pressure surface whose jets reconstruct the complete common-action source.
After exact memory subtraction, binary renewal divisibility forces a linear
Palatini--Holst face score, connection stationarity controls torsion, and
potential and counterterm forces are exactness statements.  Hodge-dominated
loaded feedback is compact and resolves, at every fixed physical scale, into
finitely many physical fields plus a vanishing high-energy tail.

The accepted/common-action comparison is likewise organized by its minimum
operational state rather than by an arbitrarily chosen coarse field.  The
initial comparison quotient is canonical.  On the output side, the
likelihood-ratio quotient is minimal when the initial comparison class remains
available, whereas the projective-column experiment quotient is minimal when
one autonomous output state and one class-independent decoder are required.
Finite future and Krylov saturation then reconstruct the minimum states for
repeated discrete and continuous evolution.  Simultaneous forward and reverse
lumpability is exactly the universal Markov-retract condition; failure produces
the Mori--Zwanzig kernel and resolvent self-energy rather than an unnamed
memory term.  The path likelihood is finitely generated by initial state,
occupation times, and directed jump counts, and its coarse chain rule exposes
hidden destination channels and irreversible fibre currents.  Protected
additive rewards give finite Feynman--Kac matrices, Perron SCGFs and
large-deviation rates.  Their Doob transforms are the unique stationary
entropy-optimal dynamics realizing exposed rare currents.  These statements
are downstream compilers: they do not supply the actual accepted kernel,
reward-resolved generator, or the regulator-uniform Perron margins.

The concrete shared-edge source already gives an autonomous renewal theorem,
not merely an available-control packet.  Independent replication has a
volume-uniform mean-zero gap, exact on-site locality, and a canonical
four-cell three-dimensional contrast frame whose normalized endpoints form a
regular tetrahedron.  This frame is not an interaction graph: all properly
connected inter-cell panels vanish on the autonomous product regulator.  The
countable product has exact local screens but noncompact global resolvent by
escaping one-site modes, and its extensive, density, and fluctuation fields
occupy respectively nontight, trivial, and tight nontrivial scaling branches.  Its active recurrent carrier has
exactly two predictive states, stationary law $(5/11,6/11)$, event flux $4/11$,
stationary metric condition number $6/5$, and exact contraction factor $7/15$.
The completed-private interarrival law is
\[
 F_W(z)=\frac{8z^2}{(5-z)(3-z)},
 \qquad
 \Pr(W>N)=6\,3^{-N}-5\,5^{-N},
\]
the endpoint is freshly and fairly written, and the retained old private record
has zero routing into the active recurrent future.  Horizon extension therefore
constructs one projectively consistent infinite marked process and physical
cylinder state.  Trace-preserving spectators and independent parallel-cell
growth are exact regulators.  A genuinely interacting regulator is governed by
the feedback kernel $BD^kC$; zero feedback is exact old-cell closure, while the
stabilized feedback-Hankel rank measures the added linear memory.  The
anticommuting score--dwell construction remains a separate optional physical

The local spacetime dimension has also ceased to be an independent loading

modulated renewal--interchange regulator; other loaded regulators must still

sector, physical unit covariance reduces the ambient writer to fifty-eight
